image_description: A low-light, high-contrast photograph of a live musical performance on a stage. A central figure wearing a dark jacket with gold trim and holding a microphone stands in profile. To the right, another musician is partially visible near a drum kit. The background features dark curtains, stage lighting rigs with red and blue lights, and silhouettes of equipment. The foreground is dominated by the silhouette of an audience member's head.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The gold trim on the jacket exhibits a smeared, painterly texture lacking distinct fabric weave or metallic reflection. The microphone head blends slightly into the hand without a clear boundary, suggesting minor generative fusion.

The drum kit lacks coherent geometric structure; cymbals and drums appear as vague, melted shapes rather than distinct rigid objects, typical of AI struggling with complex mechanical assemblies in low light.

The foreground head is extremely blurry and lacks definition. While this could be depth-of-field, the edges bleed into the background slightly unnaturally, though it is less severe than other artifacts.
